technique_name: What literary elements and devices were used in the poem "To a Skylark"?
description: In "To a Skylark" by Percy Bysshe Shelley, literary elements such as metaphor, simile, personification, apostrophe and alliteration are used. The imagery of nature, the vastness of the sky, and the beauty of the skylark are also used as rhetorical devices. Shelley uses the metaphor of a skylark to symbolize an ideal of freedom, as skylarks fly precariously high and free in the sky.
